title: Individual engineering capstone with supervisor-scoped GenAI use
summary: Final-year electrical and computer engineering students complete individual, design-focused capstone projects. Each supervisor documents project-specific GenAI permissions, which may cover research, code, data, analysis, editing, planning, or prediction; students must still justify and validate engineering decisions.

sources.title: WIP Productive Uses of Generative AI: Preliminary Findings from an Electrical and Computer Engineering Capstone Course
sources.evidence_quote: The policy permits use as specified by project supervisors. This permitted use is itemized by supervisors and becomes part of the project's documentation.

assessment.summary: Complete an individual engineering design project under a supervisor-defined GenAI policy.
student_actions: Plan and execute an individual engineering design project.
Use GenAI only for tasks approved by the supervisor.
Validate AI outputs and explain project work when required.

student_role.description: Permission varies by project and supervisor; 21 of 38 projects used GenAI.
